seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in {city}
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In {city} it currently holds {toilets} public toilets and {water} places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
